title: Fema / RBI | Retracted Statement Corroborated by Seized Records: FERA Contravention Upheld
description: SAFEMA Tribunal upholds FERA Section 8(1) contravention on corroborated evidence but reduces ₹1 crore penalty to ₹15 lakh.The post Retracted Statement Corroborated by Seized Records: FERA Contravention Upheld appeared first on TaxGuru.
